jobs.label: Wheeled SAM launcher
jobs.description: Olive-drab six-wheel military air-defense launcher truck: three narrow rubber tire top bands on each side, flat armored cab roof at NORTH/front, broad rear equipment platform at SOUTH/back. A compact raised swiveling mount on the rear platform holds FOUR long rectangular launch canisters in two paired banks, aimed north over the cab and nearly horizontal in plan. Closed rectangular canister tops, tiny forward edge-on mouths, no upward-facing pipe holes. Dark roof windows, narrow engine grille top, center sensor box and short antenna. Coherent modern SAM vehicle silhouette, military weathering, no external crew or extra vehicles.
jobs.prompt: Use case: image-edit. Correct the launcher direction in ALL FOUR cells. Cab/vehicle nose remains at screen north. Turn the four canisters so the firing tips point NORTH above the cab, almost horizontal along the image plane. Canister rear caps and exhaust ports are SOUTH; their north tips extend toward the windshield. Show only flat canister TOPS with thin edge-on front rims. There must not be visible round upward-facing openings. Keep the six-wheel silhouette, olive painted style, source cell centers, four subtle radar idle poses and transparent cell gutters. Do not turn the truck.

MATCH the reference atlas's exact same vehicle, design, camera, footprint, scale and panel positions in every cell. Front and weapon firing direction NORTH/top. STRICT vertical overhead orthographic. Wheels are top tread bands, only roof tops; no isometric tilt, perspective or body side faces. Fixed chassis coordinates and identical rigid body. Genuine transparent alpha, no text, scenery or backdrop. The FOUR poses in row-major order are four distinct travel tread/suspension keyposes: tire top tread pattern advances slightly and antenna settles, but chassis stays fixed, level and rigid. Four closed canister TOPS lie north-south aimed north with their tiny front rims NORTH over cab and closed rear caps SOUTH. No firing or smoke, no canister changes, no turning.
